name: iPhone Use
description: Lets Codex and other coding agents operate a real iPhone over USB through a local MCP server: open apps, read screens, tap, swipe and type. For macOS users with Xcode.

skills.name: App navigation
skills.description: Opens a target app and moves into its search, detail, settings or draft pages.

skills.name: Screen reading
skills.description: Returns a compact control tree with text and positions, plus real screenshots of the phone.

skills.name: Taps and gestures
skills.description: Taps by control or coordinate, swipes and drags, and waits for an on-screen target to appear.

skills.name: Text input
skills.description: Types full Unicode text, including Chinese, and splits long text into resumable segments.

skills.name: List search and collection
skills.description: Scrolls lists within bounds, reads with overlap and deduplicates, reporting the range it covered.
